narrative.headline: Right on the cut line
narrative.blurb: The Jays are within shouting distance of the last wild-card spot. This is a real October hunt. Momentum check: they are riding a W1 streak.

magicNumber.hint: Jays wins + CLE losses to clinch a playoff spot
magicNumber.detail: Any mix of Jays wins and CLE losses that adds to 18 locks a playoff spot. Winning out still requires 2 CLE losses. East title is 32 vs TB.

injuries.name: Jazz Chisholm Jr.
injuries.comment: Chisholm is not in the Yankees' starting lineup against the Padres on Saturday.

injuries.name: Ryan Weathers
injuries.comment: Weathers (forearm) did some flat-ground throwing from 75 feet Tuesday, Pete Caldera of The Bergen Record reports.

injuries.name: Fernando Cruz
injuries.comment: Cruz (elbow) expects to resume a throwing program by the end of this week, Meredith Marakovits of YES Network reports.

injuries.name: Trent Grisham
injuries.comment: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Sunday that Grisham has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 right hamstring strain and is without a definitive recovery timetable but "could be" out for the remainder of the regular season, Chris Kirschner of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Clarke Schmidt
injuries.comment: Schmidt (elbow) completed two-thirds of an inning in a rehab appearance with Double-A Somerset on Saturday, allowing two runs on two hits -- including one home run -- while striking out two batters.

injuries.name: Kervin Castro
injuries.comment: The Yankees transferred Castro (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.comment: The Yankees transferred Stanton (calf) to the 60-day injured list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Willson Contreras
injuries.comment: Contreras (hamstring) took batting practice on the field at Fenway Park on Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Justin Slaten
injuries.comment: Interim manager Chad Tracy said Monday that Slaten (elbow) has been shut down from throwing, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.

injuries.name: Kutter Crawford
injuries.comment: Crawford (forearm) is expected to remain on the injured list for the rest of the season, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Johan Oviedo
injuries.comment: Oviedo (elbow) threw a live batting practice session Friday, Christopher Smith of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Ceddanne Rafaela
injuries.comment: Boston placed Rafaela on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to a right quadriceps strain.

injuries.name: Tanner Houck
injuries.comment: Houck (elbow) is expected to begin a rehab assignment at Double-A Portland on Tuesday, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Garrett Crochet
injuries.comment: Crochet (shoulder) threw 16 pitches off a mound Friday, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyron Guerrero
injuries.comment: The Red Sox placed Guerrero on the 15-day injured list Tuesday with right shoulder inflammation.

injuries.name: Eduardo Rivera
injuries.comment: The Red Sox recalled Rivera from Triple-A Worcester and placed him on the 60-day injured list Tuesday due to a lumbar strain.

injuries.name: Curtis Mead
injuries.comment: Mead (wrist) played catch on the field at Fenway Park on Monday, Mac Cerullo of the Boston Herald reports.

injuries.name: Masataka Yoshida
injuries.comment: Interim manager Chad Tracy revealed Tuesday that Yoshida has a "significant" left hamstring injury that will keep him out until close to the end of the season, at minimum, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Triston Casas
injuries.comment: Casas (abdomen/knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Thursday.

injuries.name: Zack Kelly
injuries.comment: The Red Sox recalled Kelly (elbow) from Triple-A Worcester and placed him on the 60-day injured list Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Chase DeLauter
injuries.comment: DeLauter (wrist) is absent from the lineup for Tuesday's tilt in Baltimore.

injuries.name: Colin Holderman
injuries.comment: The Guardians placed Holderman on the 15-day injured list Friday with right wrist inflammation, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Rhys Hoskins
injuries.comment: Hoskins (back) is feeling better but has not yet resumed baseball activity, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Shawn Armstrong
injuries.comment: Armstrong (calf) threw a bullpen session Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Santander
injuries.comment: Santander (shoulder) will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Trey Yesavage
injuries.comment: Yesavage (knee) is expected to face hitters in live batting practice Thursday, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Cody Ponce
injuries.comment: Manager John Schneider said that Ponce (knee) would be a candidate to return from the 60-day injured list only if the Blue Jays make the postseason and advanced deep into October, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Patrick Corbin
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Saturday that Corbin (shoulder) is a "long shot" to return from the 60-day injured list this season, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Shane Bieber
injuries.comment: Manager John Schneider said Saturday that he hopes Bieber (shoulder) will be cleared to throw off a mound sometime next week, Keegan Matheson of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jameson Taillon
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays placed Taillon on the 15-day injured list Saturday due to right elbow inflammation.

injuries.name: Jonatan Clase
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays transferred Clase (foot) to the 60-day injured list Thursday, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Yimi Garcia
injuries.comment: Garcia (elbow/neck/biceps) underwent thoracic outlet surgery Thursday and will miss the rest of the season, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jake Bloss
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays recalled Bloss from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday and placed him on the 60-day injured list while he recovers from a right teres major strain, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Luis Urias
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays announced Monday that Urias (quadriceps) will be shut down for the next two weeks, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Addison Barger
injuries.comment: Barger is expected to be sidelined six months following surgery Monday to repair his right elbow UCL, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jose Berrios
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said that Berrios underwent full Tommy John surgery Wednesday in addition to having a stress fracture repaired, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Bowden Francis
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays placed Francis (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Wednesday.

injuries.name: Josh Jung
injuries.comment: Jung (calf) went 2-for-5 with a double and an RBI for Triple-A Round Rock on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.comment: Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said Sunday that Eovaldi could pitch in a multiple-inning relief role once he returns from the 15-day injured list before "hopefully" building up enough length to make spot starts if necessary or if time permits, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports. "It's just really challenging to think we're getting six innings out of him [immediately when he returns]," Schumaker said of Eovaldi.

injuries.name: Jack Leiter
injuries.comment: Leiter (ankle/biceps) is heading to Arizona to resume his rehab, Shawn McFarland of the Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Higashioka
injuries.comment: Higashioka (forearm) served as the designated hitter and went 1-for-5 for Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.

injuries.name: Cole Winn
injuries.comment: The Rangers placed Winn on the 15-day injured list Monday due to a right rotator cuff strain.

injuries.name: Peyton Gray
injuries.comment: Texas placed Gray on the 15-day injured list Monday due to right elbow inflammation.

injuries.name: Carter Baumler
injuries.comment: Baumler (intercostal) will begin a rehab assignment for Triple-A Round Rock this week, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jose Corniell
injuries.comment: The Rangers placed Corniell on the 15-day injured list Tuesday with an elbow injury, Jeff Wilson of AllDLLS.com reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Beeks
injuries.comment: The Rangers transferred Beeks (forearm) to the 60-day injured list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Michael Helman
injuries.comment: Texas transferred Helman (hand) to the 60-day injured list Friday.

injuries.name: Blaze Alexander
injuries.comment: Alexander will start at second base and bat leadoff in Sunday's game against the Red Sox, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Gunnar Henderson
injuries.comment: Henderson went 4-for-4 with two home runs, a triple, five total RBI and three total runs scored in Sunday's 8-5 win over the Athletics.

injuries.name: Ryan Mountcastle
injuries.comment: Mountcastle (foot/oblique) has resumed a hitting progression, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Christian Franklin
injuries.comment: Franklin (hand) has begun a hitting progression, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Ryan Helsley
injuries.comment: Helsley (elbow) will throw a live batting practice session Tuesday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Felix Bautista
injuries.comment: Manager Craig Albernaz said Monday that Bautista's (shoulder) return from the 60-day injured list isn't imminent, Matt Weyrich of The Baltimore Sun reports.

injuries.name: Tyler O'Neill
injuries.comment: Manager Craig Albernaz said Monday that O'Neill's shoulder isn't responding to rehab the way they'd hoped, and he's dealing with a "significant" injury, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Luis Robert Jr.
injuries.comment: The Orioles placed Robert on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to left hamstring discomfort.

injuries.name: Colin Selby
injuries.comment: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Friday that Selby underwent right shoulder surgery Tuesday to repair his labrum and rotator cuff, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Akin
injuries.comment: Akin (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Jake Rill of MLB.com  reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Westburg
injuries.comment: Westburg (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Andrew Golden of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Austin Martin
injuries.comment: Martin (hamstring) will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday, Aaron Gleeman of AaronGleeman.com reports.

injuries.name: Byron Buxton
injuries.comment: The Twins placed Buxton on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to a right hip impingement.

injuries.name: Mike Paredes
injuries.comment: The Twins transferred Paredes (oblique) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Saturday.

injuries.name: Cole Sands
injuries.comment: Sands will undergo arthroscopic surgery Tuesday to remove loose bodies and bone spurs from his right elbow, Jack Azoulay-Haron of ElEmergente.com reports.

injuries.name: David Festa
injuries.comment: Festa (shoulder) will undergo a season-ending double surgery Wednesday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Mick Abel
injuries.comment: The Twins plan to re-evaluate Abel (elbow) on Sept. 1, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Banda
injuries.comment: Banda underwent surgery to repair his left lat strain and will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Pablo Lopez
injuries.comment: The Twins placed Lopez (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Thursday.

injuries.name: Nick Davila
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Davila on the 15-day injured list Monday with a right SC joint sprain in his shoulder.

injuries.name: Matt Brash
injuries.comment: Brash has been shut down from throwing for eight weeks after an MRI revealed more inflammation in his lat, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Brendan Donovan
injuries.comment: Donovan continues to experience concussion symptoms, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Brennen Davis
injuries.comment: The Mariners recalled Davis (hamstring) from Triple-A Tacoma on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

injuries.name: Colt Emerson
injuries.comment: The Mariners transferred Emerson (wrist) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Monday.

injuries.name: Emerson Hancock
injuries.comment: Seattle placed Hancock (groin) on the 15-day injured list Sunday with a left adductor strain, retroactive to Aug. 29.

injuries.name: Luke Raley
injuries.comment: The Mariners transferred Raley (forearm) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Cole Wilcox
injuries.comment: Wilcox left Thursday's game versus the Tigers due to left oblique tightness.

injuries.name: Will Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (thumb) has gone 3-for-9 with two RBI and a 1:2 BB:K in his first three rehab games between High-A Everett and Triple-A Tacoma.

injuries.name: Logan Evans
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Evans (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Monday.

playoffOdds.method: Monte Carlo of remaining American League games. Each game uses log5 win odds from Pythagorean record, season record, last-10 form, home-field advantage, and injured-list drag.
playoffOdds.note: 36.3% of 5,000 sims have Toronto as a division winner or one of the three AL wild cards. Models 159 remaining games involving AL clubs.
